display_name: DURA 源模拟信道作用与先验联合训练Phase1 七景测试
description: DURA 可训练副本在源 IQ 损失和冻结原版保护上，额外用源模拟信道作用监督固定复探针响应，联合更新物理估计与先验；推理不需要模拟真值。

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA v1.0 stage2 E20/4940 source-only checkpoint; trainable independent copy and separate frozen original reference
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura validates original7/63/30 and original DURA F/TX/target access fields; candidate and anchor are separate copies
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source-only original DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Reset AdamW, fixed final 5 incremental epochs after parent E20; no source or target score selection

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent

rows.method: Internally refine DURA with source IQ loss and DURA guard plus 0.01 log-normalized source simulator action response loss
rows.purpose: Complete mandatory Phase1 seven-view test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: Original DURA seed 2026092701, source fit sampling 2026110611, optimizer order 2026110613; no new random model initialization.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views

notes: Frozen original DURA anchor and separately trainable same-source candidate; source IQ/guard plus 0.01 mean log1p normalized action response error on a fixed complex probe and its i rotation.
Source simulator kernel/main/image are privileged source-only training labels, same physical IDs and views; target inference uses only received IQ. Simulator variance is not supervised.
Probe random seed 2026110614. This supervises only two action responses, not guaranteed full-operator identification.
No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target data in training. Reset AdamW lr=1e-5, weight decay 0, five fixed epochs.
All seven Phase1 views run and score truth-last regardless of source metrics; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after model freeze.
